name: @pipeworx/mcp-sefaria

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Fetch a passage of Jewish text from Sefaria by reference, in Hebrew and/or English. Works for Torah/Tanakh, Talmud, Mishnah, Midrash, Halacha, Kabbalah, and commentaries. Keyless.

tools.name: lookup_ref
tools.description: Validate or autocomplete a Sefaria reference or title (e.g. "Genesis", "Rashi", "Berakhot"). Returns whether it is a valid reference/book and a list of completions. Keyless.

name.description: A partial title or reference to validate/autocomplete.

tools.name: get_commentaries
tools.description: List the commentaries and cross-references on a passage (e.g. Rashi, Targum, quoting commentaries) from Sefaria's link graph. Keyless.

category.description: Filter to links of this category, case-insensitive (e.g. "Commentary", "Targum"). Default "Commentary".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sefaria forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sefaria pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
